title: 第五章 闯祸小爷是受嘉奖呢第六章 贾环受奖宝玉生妒
slug: 红楼我乃宗师贾环当登基为帝
lines: 夕阳西下。
贾环在营殿记下归巡登记，便乐呵呵的回了荣国府。
岂料！这才刚一进门，便见一个头戴乌纱，身着石青团领衫，腰束革带的中年男子，冷声问道：
“贾环何在！”
什么情况？
贾环有些懵，脑中飞速运转。
直至瞧见那男子身侧的熟面孔，这才瞬间恍然。
嘿！没想到啊，这捕头的办事效率还挺高！
自个午间刚帮的忙，他傍晚边就带人报喜了！
贾环兴冲冲的，刚要上前接话。
岂料这时，一道浑厚低沉的嗓音却从侧方传来！
“你个孽子！让你去京营历练，你竟又敢在外头闯祸，还惹得五城兵马司指挥使亲自登门！”
贾环愣了愣神，下意识扭头望去。
只见那训斥之人，正是贾政！
贾政一袭深灰绸缎长袍，外罩石青褂子，腰系玉饰腰带，头戴方巾，脚蹬皂靴，一副儒雅稳重的做派。
可那盯着贾环的眼神，却冰冷至极！
一旁随行的贾政之妻王夫人，面带笑意，瞧着倒是慈眉善目，却鲜少有人知她佛口蛇心。
“环儿，得亏你这会被老爷撞上，若真叫五城兵马司带去了，想出来，怕是不容易了。”
王夫人仪态雍容，语调温和，“还傻愣着做什么？快些同老爷认个错，好叫他帮你平息了去。”
认错？
贾环皱了皱眉，深知自己祸事越多，便越叫这王夫人得意。
毕竟一山不容二虎，她亲生子贾宝玉整日流连在莺莺燕燕，无心学业。
若自己这个庶子工学善书，科举入仕，那才真真叫人头大呢！
不过很可惜。
他今儿个还真没闯祸！
“我没有……”
“你还敢胡诌？！”
贾政愠色打断，一边怒斥，一边快步上前，“你自个瞧瞧，人都找上门来拿你，你还敢狡辩？满口胡言的玩意，今日我非打死你不可！”
怒斥间，贾政也不问缘由，抬脚就朝贾环踹去！
嘭！
一道闷声骤响。
可倒在的那个，却不是贾环！
“哎呦！”
贾政四脚朝天，疼得直抽凉气。
见状，贾环微眯着眼，心底生出一丝冷笑。
开玩笑，就算他只觉醒了一级的凌波微步，对付你个老登还不是绰绰有余？
“哎呀父亲，你怎么这么不小心啊？”贾环嘴上忧虑，眼中却是藏不住的戏谑。
“环儿，老爷都这般年纪了，你怎可故意躲开，让他摔了！若摔出个好歹可如何是好？”
王夫人添油加醋。
而当众失仪，更叫贾政怒火攻心！
content_en:
The sun sets.
Jia Huan recorded the return patrol registration in the camp hall and returned to Rongguo Mansion happily.
Unexpectedly! As soon as he entered the door, he saw a middle-aged man wearing a black veil on his head, an azure collared shirt, and a leather belt around his waist. He asked coldly:
"Where is Jia Huan!"
What's going on?
Jia Huan was a little confused, his mind racing.
It wasn't until I saw the familiar face beside the man that I suddenly understood.
Hey! Unexpectedly, the efficiency of this head catcher is quite high!
I just helped out at noon, and he brought someone to announce the good news in the evening!
"I am..."
Jia Huan was excited and was about to step forward to answer the question.
Unexpectedly, at this moment, a deep and deep voice came from the side!
"You evil son! I asked you to go to the Beijing Camp to practice, but you dared to cause trouble outside, and even provoked the commander of the Five Cities Soldiers and Horses Division to come to the door in person!"
Jia Huan was stunned and subconsciously turned his head to look.
I saw that the person who was reprimanding was none other than Jia Zheng!
Jia Zheng wore a dark gray satin robe, an azure gown, a jade belt around his waist, a square scarf on his head, and soap boots on his feet. He looked elegant and steady.
But the eyes staring at Jia Huan were extremely cold!
Mrs. Wang, Jia Zheng's wife, who was accompanying him, had a smile on her face and a kind-hearted look on her face, but few people knew that she was a talkative but a snake-hearted person.
"Huan'er, it's a good thing that you will be hit by the master now. If you really ask the Five Cities Soldiers and Horses Division to take you away, I'm afraid it won't be easy to figure it out."
Mrs. Wang's demeanor was graceful and her tone was gentle, "What are you still doing stupidly? Quickly admit your mistake to the master so that he can help you calm down."
Admit your mistake?
Jia Huan frowned, knowing that the more troubles he caused, the more proud he would be of Mrs. Wang.
After all, there is no room for two tigers in one mountain. Her biological son Jia Baoyu hangs around Yingying Yanyan all day long and has no intention of studying.
If a concubine like me were good at studying and became an official in the imperial examination, that would really be a big deal!
But it's a pity.
He really didn't get into trouble today!
"I didn't..."
"How dare you make such nonsense?!"
Jia Zheng interrupted sullenly, scolded angrily, and stepped forward quickly, "Just look at it, people are coming to get you, and you still dare to quibble? You are full of nonsense, I have to beat you to death today!"
While scolding, Jia Zheng didn't ask why, he kicked Jia Huan with his foot!
Bang!
There was a muffled sound.
But the one who fell was not Jia Huan!
"Ouch!"
Jia Zheng was on his back, gasping in pain.
Seeing this, Jia Huan narrowed his eyes slightly and sneered in his heart.
Just kidding, even if he only awakens the first level of Lingbo Weibu, wouldn't it be more than enough to deal with you, an old man?
"Oh, father, why are you so careless?" Jia Huan said worriedly, but there was a hint of teasing in his eyes.
"Huan'er, I'm so old, how could you deliberately avoid him and let him fall! What should I do if he falls?"
Mrs. Wang added fuel to the fire.
And his disobedience in public made Jia Zheng furious!
title_en: Chapter 5: Is the troublemaker receiving a reward? Chapter 6: Jia Huan is jealous of Baoyu after receiving the award
